message: Hi, I'm a student with a app development certification background. My overall academic average is 72.1% in an IT/computer-science degree. I'm interested in programming and cloud computing. I want to become a CRM Technical Developer. My family can afford at most about USD 2800 per year. I live in Chennai. I'm open to anywhere in India.

other_constraints: Interested in programming and cloud computing

explanation:
This MTech in Pune offers strong alignment with your interests (networking/cloud) and has a high placement rate. Crucially, its tuition ($2050) is well within your budget, and the minimum grade requirement (70%) is achievable given your 72.1% average.

Located in Chennai, this MTech program focuses on cloud computing and has a very low tuition fee ($2300), making it highly budget-friendly. While the minimum grade is 74%, your current average of 72.1% is close enough to consider applying.

This MSc Cloud Computing program in Coimbatore has a manageable tuition fee ($2400) and covers both cloud computing and software engineering. The minimum grade requirement (64%) is easily met by your academic average.

This MSc Cloud Computing program in Delhi has a low tuition fee ($1700) and directly addresses your interest in cloud computing. Since it requires a CS background, your current degree is suitable, and the cost is excellent for your budget.

This MSc Cloud Computing program in Chennai offers one of the lowest tuition fees ($550) while still focusing on cloud computing. It requires a CS background, making it relevant to your profile and highly affordable.
